# Tokcat

> Tokcat is an AI token usage monitor for the macOS menu bar: a Claude Code usage tracker, Codex usage tracker, Cursor usage dashboard, and LLM cost tracker for AI coding agent usage across Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor IDE, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI, Amp, Droid, Hermes, and Grok Build. It visualizes token usage as a recent 30-day 2D stacked token chart and a full-year 3D GitHub-style contribution graph. A native Swift/SwiftUI app, distributed via Homebrew and GitHub Releases as one universal build for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs, macOS 13+. MIT licensed.

## Install

- [Homebrew](https://github.com/handlecusion/tokcat#quick-start): `brew install --cask handlecusion/tokcat/tokcat`
- [DMG download](https://github.com/handlecusion/tokcat/releases/latest)
- [Homebrew tap repository](https://github.com/handlecusion/homebrew-tokcat)

## Architecture

- [App shell source](https://github.com/handlecusion/tokcat/tree/main/native/Tokcat): Swift app target, XcodeGen project, Info.plist
- [Core package source](https://github.com/handlecusion/tokcat/tree/main/native/LocalPackage): SwiftPM package layered UserInterface → Model → DataSource, with log parsers, pricing, tailer, and quota providers in Collector; SceneKit 3D graph
- [tokscale upstream](https://github.com/junhoyeo/tokscale): reference project for supported local log formats

## Supported AI clients

Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Cursor IDE, OpenCode, Google Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Amp, Droid, Hermes, and Grok Build.

## Privacy

No telemetry. No cloud sync. No Tokcat account. Network access is limited to the Sparkle appcast on GitHub Releases (checked on launch and hourly) and direct Codex/Claude/Grok/Cursor quota lookups when local credentials are available. Token-usage history is read locally from session logs.
